essence: Whatever a creature prays for, it always obtains that very thing.
By performing oblation unweariedly in this way, one always obtains everything.
One should perform the fire offering with red flowers in the fire pit according to rule.
Even grave sins like killing parents, and what to say of other minor sins, are rendered inconsequential.
Whomever the mantrin touches and recites over, that very person he brings under control.
